sections.title: Passage 01 - Green Guangzhou
raw_text: Guangzhou has set a goal to become a model green city in China.
With the vision of "Blue Skies and Clean Waters", the city is working hard to 1. r________ pollution.
In 2024, the government launched a special movement to fight against air pollution.
Over 100 factories have upgraded their equipment, making the air 2. f________.
Citizens are also joining in creative ways.
Last year, communities and middle schools started a "Bottle Recycling Week" and 3. c________ nearly 5,000 plastic bottles to build art sculptures.
As the government and citizens work 4. t________, Guangzhou is proving that economic growth and environmental protection can go hand in hand.
The upcoming 15th National Games will show Guangzhou's green efforts.
All stadiums will use solar 5. e________ and athletes will drink water with reusable bamboo cups.
As the city motto says, "Green Guangzhou, Our Shared Home!"
filled_text: Guangzhou has set a goal to become a model green city in China.
With the vision of "Blue Skies and Clean Waters", the city is working hard to reduce pollution.
In 2024, the government launched a special movement to fight against air pollution.
Over 100 factories have upgraded their equipment, making the air fresher.
Citizens are also joining in creative ways.
Last year, communities and middle schools started a "Bottle Recycling Week" and collected nearly 5,000 plastic bottles to build art sculptures.
As the government and citizens work together, Guangzhou is proving that economic growth and environmental protection can go hand in hand.
The upcoming 15th National Games will show Guangzhou's green efforts.
All stadiums will use solar energy and athletes will drink water with reusable bamboo cups.
As the city motto says, "Green Guangzhou, Our Shared Home!"
filled_text_cn: 广州定下目标，要成为中国的绿色模范城市。
本着“蓝天碧水”的愿景，该市正努力减少污染。
2024年，政府发起了一项治理空气污染的专项行动。
100多家工厂更新了设备，使空气更加清新。
市民们也以富有创意的方式参与其中。
去年，社区和中学开展了“瓶子回收周”活动，收集了近5000个塑料瓶用于制作艺术雕塑。
在政府和市民的共同努力下，广州正证明经济增长与环境保护可以并行不悖。
即将到来的第十五届全运会将展示广州的绿色努力。
所有体育场馆都将使用太阳能，运动员将用可重复使用的竹杯喝水。
正如城市口号所说：“绿色广州，共同家园！”

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词不定式作目的状语
questions.explanation: 根据前文“become a model green city”和“Blue Skies and Clean Waters”及首字母r可知，广州正努力“减少”污染；不定式符号to后接动词原形，故填reduce。
questions.rule_summary: work hard to do sth. 意为“努力做某事”，to后接动词原形。

questions.explanation: 工厂更新设备是为了使空气（比以前）“更清新”，make + 宾语 + 形容词（比较级）作宾语补足语，结合首字母f可知填fresher（fresh也符合语境）。
questions.rule_summary: make sth. + adj. 表示“使某物处于某种状态”，语境含前后对比时可用比较级。

questions.explanation: 由时间状语“Last year”及并列谓语“started”可知应用一般过去时；结合“nearly 5,000 plastic bottles to build art sculptures”和首字母c，指“收集”塑料瓶，故填collected。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时中and连接的并列谓语动词时态需保持一致。

questions.explanation: 句意为“在政府和市民的共同努力下”，work together意为“共同努力、一起合作”，结合首字母t，故填together。
questions.rule_summary: 副词together修饰动词work，表示“一起，共同”。

questions.explanation: 根据“solar...”和绿色的全运会语境及首字母e可知，体育场馆都将使用“太阳能”，solar energy为常见搭配，energy为不可数名词，故填energy。
questions.rule_summary: solar energy 意为“太阳能”，energy作“能源”讲时为不可数名词。

sections.title: Passage 02 - Advice on Reducing Stress
raw_text: Dear Jenny,
I am sorry to hear that you have been under great stress.
You feel sad, or even angry.
I want you to know that these feelings are 1. c________.
Many teenagers suffer from stress in their daily lives.
First, remember to take a 2. b________ when you need it.
Sometimes, just resting for a few minutes can help you feel 3. r________.
Exercise is also good for your health.
Even a short walk can help clear your mind and reduce stress.
When you are not happy, try to do something you enjoy.
4. W________ it's reading a book, listening to music, or spending time with friends, a hobby can help you feel more positive.
And always remember, it's okay to ask for help.
There are many people around to love and 5. s________ you.
filled_text: Dear Jenny,
I am sorry to hear that you have been under great stress.
You feel sad, or even angry.
I want you to know that these feelings are common.
Many teenagers suffer from stress in their daily lives.
First, remember to take a break when you need it.
Sometimes, just resting for a few minutes can help you feel relaxed.
Exercise is also good for your health.
Even a short walk can help clear your mind and reduce stress.
When you are not happy, try to do something you enjoy.
Whether it's reading a book, listening to music, or spending time with friends, a hobby can help you feel more positive.
And always remember, it's okay to ask for help.
There are many people around to love and support you.
filled_text_cn: 亲爱的珍妮：
听说你最近承受着很大的压力，我很难过。
你感到难过，甚至生气。
我想让你知道，这些感受是很常见的。
许多青少年在日常生活中都饱受压力困扰。
首先，记得在需要的时候休息一下。
有时候，仅仅休息几分钟就能让你感到放松。
锻炼对你的健康也有好处。
哪怕只是短暂散步，也能帮你理清思绪、减轻压力。
当你不开心时，试着做一些你喜欢的事情。
无论是读书、听音乐，还是和朋友在一起，爱好都能让你感觉更积极。
而且永远记住，寻求帮助是没有关系的。
你身边有很多爱你、支持你的人。

questions.explanation: 根据后文“Many teenagers suffer from stress in their daily lives.”及首字母c可知，这些感受是“常见的”，形容词common作表语，故填common。
questions.rule_summary: be动词后接形容词作表语，common意为“常见的、普遍的”。

questions.explanation: 根据后文“just resting for a few minutes”及首字母b可知，此处表示“休息一下”，take a break为固定搭配，故填break。
questions.rule_summary: take a break 为固定短语，意为“休息一下”。

questions.explanation: 休息几分钟能帮助你感到“放松”，系动词feel后接修饰人的形容词relaxed，故填relaxed。
questions.rule_summary: feel后接形容词作表语，-ed形容词relaxed用于描述人的感受。

questions.explanation: 根据后文“...or spending time with friends”可知，此处构成“whether ... or ...”结构，意为“无论是……还是……”，引导让步状语从句，句首首字母大写，故填Whether。
questions.rule_summary: whether ... or ... 引导让步状语从句，意为“无论是……还是……”。

questions.explanation: 结合前文“it's okay to ask for help”和“love and ... you”以及首字母s可知，身边有很多人爱你并“支持”你；与love并列在不定式符号to后，用动词原形support。
questions.rule_summary: to love and support 中and连接两个并列的不定式动词，第二个动词省去to并用原形。

sections.title: Passage 03 - Challenges of Flying to Mars
raw_text: Flying to Mars would be the farthest journey in human history.
For the astronauts who visit Mars, they would 1. s________ a lot because of the special environment there.
Surviving this trip would not be easy.
Though space travel is never free of 2. d________, it takes a lot more health risks to travel in space for a long time.
For one thing, staying in space for long periods makes the human body 3. w________.
Also, it puts pressure on the back of the eyes and causes eye problems.
Then there are space rays to 4. w________ about.
It might lead to a higher chance of health problems, especially for astronauts who will have long journeys.
Astronauts will have to pack 5. l________ to lift off from Earth.
And they won't be able to get things they need like astronauts on the space station do.
Instead, they will take fewer things and they might try growing food and building tools as needed.
filled_text: Flying to Mars would be the farthest journey in human history.
For the astronauts who visit Mars, they would suffer a lot because of the special environment there.
Surviving this trip would not be easy.
Though space travel is never free of danger, it takes a lot more health risks to travel in space for a long time.
For one thing, staying in space for long periods makes the human body weak.
Also, it puts pressure on the back of the eyes and causes eye problems.
Then there are space rays to worry about.
It might lead to a higher chance of health problems, especially for astronauts who will have long journeys.
Astronauts will have to pack light to lift off from Earth.
And they won't be able to get things they need like astronauts on the space station do.
Instead, they will take fewer things and they might try growing food and building tools as needed.
filled_text_cn: 飞往火星将是人类历史上最遥远的旅程。
对于造访火星的宇航员来说，由于那里的特殊环境，他们会遭受很多痛苦。
在这趟旅程中存活下来并不容易。
虽然太空旅行从来都不是没有危险的，但长时间在太空中旅行会带来更多的健康风险。
一方面，长时间待在太空会使人体变得虚弱。
此外，它还会对眼球后部施加压力，引发眼部问题。
还有太空射线需要担心。
这可能会导致更高的健康问题风险，尤其是对于将进行长途旅行的宇航员而言。
宇航员必须轻装从地球起飞。
而且他们无法像空间站上的宇航员那样获取所需物品。
相反，他们会携带更少的东西，并可能尝试按需种植食物和制造工具。

questions.grammar_point_name: 情态动词后接动词原形
questions.explanation: 由于火星的特殊环境，宇航员会“遭受”很多痛苦；情态动词would后接动词原形，结合首字母s，故填suffer。
questions.rule_summary: 情态动词would后接动词原形，suffer a lot 意为“受很多苦”。

questions.explanation: 根据后文“health risks”及首字母d可知，太空旅行从来都不是没有“危险”的；free of danger意为“没有危险”，故填danger。
questions.rule_summary: free of + 名词 表示“免于……、没有……”，danger作“危险”讲时为不可数名词。

questions.explanation: 长时间待在太空会使人体“虚弱”；make + 宾语 + 形容词作宾补，结合首字母w，故填weak。
questions.rule_summary: make + 宾语 + adj. 表示“使……变得……”。

questions.explanation: 根据空后“about”及语境可知，还有太空射线需要“担心”；worry about为固定搭配，不定式符号to后接动词原形，故填worry。
questions.rule_summary: worry about 意为“担心”，to worry about 作后置定语修饰space rays。

questions.explanation: 根据下文“Instead, they will take fewer things”及首字母l可知，此处指“轻装”出行，pack light为固定搭配（light作副词，意为“轻便地”），故填light。
questions.rule_summary: pack light 为常见表达，意为“轻装上阵”。

sections.title: Passage 04 - Robots at the Spring Festival
raw_text: This past Chinese New Year, 16 robots took center stage at the CCTV Spring Festival Gala (央视春晚) while dancing the Yangge.
They moved smoothly and matched human dancers perfectly.
Robots all across China showed off their skills during the festival.
In Beijing, a new robot-themed park opened with tea-serving robots.
A Shenzhen company's robots wrote the Chinese 1. c________ "fu" in a video.
They also cleaned homes, cooked tangyuan and even set off fireworks.
At an AI temple fair in Beijing, a Cai Shen Ye robot joked around with a kid.
Everyone 2. l________.
According to its creator, the robot gets better at answering questions over time as it is able to learn from talking with people.
Elsewhere at the temple fair, a robot made coffee with pretty coffee art 3. l________ flowers and leaves.
A 19-year-old student, Wang Yuyao, said it was his first time seeing such 4. b________ coffee art from a robot.
"It shows that robots and AI are developing 5. f________," he said.
"As a student studying computer chips, I feel hopeful about the future."
filled_text: This past Chinese New Year, 16 robots took center stage at the CCTV Spring Festival Gala while dancing the Yangge.
They moved smoothly and matched human dancers perfectly.
Robots all across China showed off their skills during the festival.
In Beijing, a new robot-themed park opened with tea-serving robots.
A Shenzhen company's robots wrote the Chinese character "fu" in a video.
They also cleaned homes, cooked tangyuan and even set off fireworks.
At an AI temple fair in Beijing, a Cai Shen Ye robot joked around with a kid.
Everyone laughed.
According to its creator, the robot gets better at answering questions over time as it is able to learn from talking with people.
Elsewhere at the temple fair, a robot made coffee with pretty coffee art like flowers and leaves.
A 19-year-old student, Wang Yuyao, said it was his first time seeing such beautiful coffee art from a robot.
"It shows that robots and AI are developing fast," he said.
"As a student studying computer chips, I feel hopeful about the future."
filled_text_cn: 在刚刚过去的春节，16个机器人登上央视春晚的中心舞台跳起了秧歌。
它们动作流畅，与人类舞者配合得天衣无缝。
节日期间，全国各地的机器人都展示了自己的技能。
在北京，一座配有端茶机器人的全新机器人主题公园开园了。
深圳一家公司的机器人在视频中写下了汉字“福”。
它们还会打扫房间、煮汤圆，甚至放烟花。
在北京的一场人工智能庙会上，一个“财神爷”机器人和一个孩子开起了玩笑。
大家都笑了。
据其创造者介绍，随着时间推移，这个机器人越来越擅长回答问题，因为它能从与人的交谈中学习。
在庙会的其他地方，一个机器人制作了带有漂亮拉花图案的咖啡，比如花朵和树叶。
19岁的学生王宇瑶说，这是他第一次看到机器人做出如此美丽的咖啡拉花。
“这表明机器人和人工智能正在快速发展，”他说。
“作为一名学习计算机芯片的学生，我对未来充满希望。”

questions.explanation: 根据空后“"fu"”及首字母c可知，此处指汉字“福”，Chinese character意为“汉字”，且特指“福”字，用单数形式character。
questions.rule_summary: Chinese character 意为“汉字”，此处特指“福”字用单数。

questions.explanation: 根据前句“a Cai Shen Ye robot joked around with a kid”可知，机器人讲笑话，大家都“笑了”；结合一般过去时态和首字母l，故填laughed。
questions.rule_summary: 描述过去发生的动作应用一般过去时，laugh的过去式为laughed。

questions.explanation: 根据空后“flowers and leaves”及首字母l可知，此处用于举例说明咖啡拉花的图案，“比如”花朵和树叶，介词like符合语境，故填like。
questions.rule_summary: 介词like可用于举例，意为“像，比如”。

questions.explanation: 呼应前文“pretty coffee art”，此处表示“如此美丽的咖啡拉花”，结合首字母b，形容词beautiful修饰名词短语coffee art，故填beautiful。
questions.rule_summary: such + adj. + 不可数名词，意为“如此……的……”。

questions.explanation: 句意为“这表明机器人和人工智能正在快速发展”，副词fast修饰动词developing，结合首字母f，故填fast。
questions.rule_summary: fast既可作形容词也可作副词，修饰动词develop表示“快速地”。

sections.title: Passage 05 - Yingge Dance
raw_text: Yingge dance is a lively and colorful folk performance with a long history in China, 1. e________ Guangdong.
It combines music, dance, and martial arts, usually performed during festivals to celebrate good 2. l________ and happiness.
Dancers wear bright costumes, wave colorful flags, and move to the beat of drums, creating an exciting atmosphere.
In the past, Yingge dance was very popular in villages, bringing people together and strengthening community spirit.
However, as modern life becomes faster, fewer young people show 3. i________ in learning this traditional art.
To protect this cultural treasure, local governments and schools are taking action by organizing performances and workshops.
Students are 4. e________ to join in and appreciate their heritage.
Guangzhou, as a cultural center, still holds Yingge dance events during important holidays.
It is 5. n________ for us to understand its value and pass it on to future generations.
By doing so, we can keep this unique tradition alive.
filled_text: Yingge dance is a lively and colorful folk performance with a long history in China, especially Guangdong.
It combines music, dance, and martial arts, usually performed during festivals to celebrate good luck and happiness.
Dancers wear bright costumes, wave colorful flags, and move to the beat of drums, creating an exciting atmosphere.
In the past, Yingge dance was very popular in villages, bringing people together and strengthening community spirit.
However, as modern life becomes faster, fewer young people show interest in learning this traditional art.
To protect this cultural treasure, local governments and schools are taking action by organizing performances and workshops.
Students are encouraged to join in and appreciate their heritage.
Guangzhou, as a cultural center, still holds Yingge dance events during important holidays.
It is necessary for us to understand its value and pass it on to future generations.
By doing so, we can keep this unique tradition alive.
filled_text_cn: 英歌舞是一种活泼多彩的中国传统民间表演艺术，历史悠久，尤其是在广东地区。
它融合了音乐、舞蹈和武术，通常在节日期间表演，以庆祝好运和幸福。
舞者身穿鲜艳的服饰，挥舞彩旗，随着鼓点起舞，营造出热烈的氛围。
过去，英歌舞在乡村非常流行，将人们凝聚在一起，增强了社区凝聚力。
然而，随着现代生活节奏加快，越来越少的年轻人对学习这门传统艺术表现出兴趣。
为了保护这一文化瑰宝，当地政府和学校正在采取行动，组织演出和工作坊。
学生们被鼓励参与其中并欣赏他们的文化遗产。
作为文化中心，广州在重要节假日期间仍会举办英歌舞活动。
我们有必要理解它的价值并将其传承给后代。
通过这样做，我们就能让这一独特的传统延续下去。

questions.explanation: 句意为“在中国历史悠久，尤其是在广东”，结合首字母e，副词especially意为“尤其、特别”，用于进一步强调地点，故填especially。
questions.rule_summary: especially 为副词，意为“尤其，特别”，常用于补充强调。

questions.explanation: 根据“celebrate good ... and happiness”及首字母l可知，节日期间表演是为了庆祝“好运”和幸福，good luck为固定搭配，故填luck。
questions.rule_summary: good luck 意为“好运”，luck为不可数名词。

questions.explanation: 根据“show ... in learning this traditional art”及首字母i可知，此处考查固定短语show interest in doing sth.（对做某事表现出兴趣），故填interest。
questions.rule_summary: show interest in (doing) sth. 意为“对……表现出兴趣”。

questions.explanation: 主语Students与动词encourage之间为被动关系，be encouraged to do sth.意为“被鼓励做某事”，结合首字母e，故填encouraged。
questions.rule_summary: be encouraged to do sth. 为被动语态结构，意为“被鼓励做某事”。

questions.grammar_point_name: It is + adj. + for sb. to do 句型
questions.explanation: 根据后文“By doing so, we can keep this unique tradition alive.”及首字母n可知，理解其价值并传承下去是“有必要的”；It is necessary for sb. to do sth.为固定句型，故填necessary。
questions.rule_summary: It is necessary for sb. to do sth. 意为“对某人来说做某事是必要的”。

sections.title: Passage 06 - The Chongyang Festival
raw_text: The Chongyang Festival, also known as the Double Ninth Festival, falls on the ninth day of the ninth month.
It is a day for people to 1. s________ respect for their elders.
There are several activities that are tied to this ancient festival.
The most 2. p________ activity is to go walking in the hills or mountains.
People often go with their elderly family 3. m________ to enjoy the beauty of nature.
They believe it can help people live 4. h________.
It is also traditional to admire the chrysanthemums (菊花) in the parks and gardens.
In fact, chrysanthemums have long been connected with the idea of long life and health in Chinese culture.
During this festival, people eat a so called Chongyang cake.
The customs of this festival are all about people's health, so it is also a day to 5. r________ people of the importance of health and family.
filled_text: The Chongyang Festival, also known as the Double Ninth Festival, falls on the ninth day of the ninth month.
It is a day for people to show respect for their elders.
There are several activities that are tied to this ancient festival.
The most popular activity is to go walking in the hills or mountains.
People often go with their elderly family members to enjoy the beauty of nature.
They believe it can help people live healthily.
It is also traditional to admire the chrysanthemums in the parks and gardens.
In fact, chrysanthemums have long been connected with the idea of long life and health in Chinese culture.
During this festival, people eat a so called Chongyang cake.
The customs of this festival are all about people's health, so it is also a day to remind people of the importance of health and family.
filled_text_cn: 重阳节，又称双九节，在农历九月初九。
这是人们向长辈表达敬意的日子。
这个古老的节日有好几项传统活动。
最受欢迎的活动是去山里登高散步。
人们经常和年迈的家庭成员一起去欣赏大自然的美景。
他们相信这能帮助人们健康地生活。
在公园和花园里赏菊也是一项传统。
事实上，在中国文化中，菊花长期以来一直与长寿和健康联系在一起。
在这个节日期间，人们会吃所谓的重阳糕。
这个节日的习俗都与人们的健康有关，所以它也是提醒人们重视健康和家庭的日子。

questions.explanation: 重阳节是人们向长辈“表达”尊敬的日子，show respect for sb.为固定搭配，to后接动词原形，故填show。
questions.rule_summary: show respect for sb. 意为“向某人表示尊敬”，不定式to后接动词原形。

questions.explanation: 根据空前“The most”和后文“go walking in the hills or mountains”及首字母p可知，最“受欢迎的”活动是登高，“the most + 多音节形容词原级”构成最高级，故填popular。
questions.rule_summary: 多音节形容词的最高级为 the most + 形容词原级。

questions.explanation: 句意为“人们经常和年迈的家庭成员一起去”，family member意为“家庭成员”，由空前their可知应用复数形式members。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词member表示复数概念时需加-s变为members。

questions.explanation: 结合后文“long life and health”及首字母h可知，登高能帮助人们“健康地”生活；修饰动词live需用副词healthily。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰实义动词需用副词，healthy去y变i加-ly构成healthily。

questions.explanation: 根据空后“people of the importance of health and family”及首字母r可知，此处考查remind sb. of sth.（提醒某人某事），不定式to后接动词原形，故填remind。
questions.rule_summary: remind sb. of sth. 为固定搭配，意为“提醒某人某事”。

sections.title: Passage 07 - Wen Tong and Bamboo
raw_text: Once there was a painter named Wen Tong.
He was 1. f________ for bamboo paintings.
Many people loved his works.
Wen Tong grew lots of bamboo around his house.
He carefully watched it every day.
After a long time, Wen Tong could 2. r________ every detail of it.
Without looking at it, he could paint bamboo which was in different seasons and different weather conditions.
Whenever Wen Tong picked up his brush, he could already think out what bamboo would look like.
He could paint bamboo 3. q________ and confidently, for he knew bamboo very well and knew it by heart.
People were amazed at the lifelike bamboo he painted in such a short time.
His friend said, "When painting bamboo, Wen Tong didn't need real bamboo in front of him because the complete image was already in his 4. m________."
Now, the idiom "xiōng yǒu chéng zhú" means that someone is confident because he or she 5. p________ well before doing things.
filled_text: Once there was a painter named Wen Tong.
He was famous for bamboo paintings.
Many people loved his works.
Wen Tong grew lots of bamboo around his house.
He carefully watched it every day.
After a long time, Wen Tong could remember every detail of it.
Without looking at it, he could paint bamboo which was in different seasons and different weather conditions.
Whenever Wen Tong picked up his brush, he could already think out what bamboo would look like.
He could paint bamboo quickly and confidently, for he knew bamboo very well and knew it by heart.
People were amazed at the lifelike bamboo he painted in such a short time.
His friend said, "When painting bamboo, Wen Tong didn't need real bamboo in front of him because the complete image was already in his mind."
Now, the idiom "xiōng yǒu chéng zhú" means that someone is confident because he or she prepares well before doing things.
filled_text_cn: 从前有一位名叫文同的画家。
他以画竹而闻名。
许多人都喜爱他的作品。
文同在自家房前屋后种了许多竹子。
他每天都仔细观察竹子。
过了很长时间，文同能够记住竹子的每一个细节。
不用看实物，他就能画出不同季节、不同天气条件下的竹子。
每当文同拿起画笔，他就已经能想出竹子会是什么样子。
他能快速而自信地画竹子，因为他非常了解竹子并牢记于心。
人们对他如此短时间内画出的栩栩如生的竹子赞叹不已。
他的朋友说：“画竹时，文同不需要面前有真正的竹子，因为完整的竹子形象早已在他脑海中了。”
如今，成语“胸有成竹”的意思是某人很自信，因为他或她在做事之前准备充分。

questions.explanation: 根据空前“was”和空后“for bamboo paintings”及首字母f可知，此处考查be famous for（以……闻名），故填famous。
questions.rule_summary: be famous for 意为“因……而闻名”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 情态动词后接动词原形
questions.explanation: 每天仔细观察，久而久之就能“记住”每一个细节；情态动词could后接动词原形，结合首字母r，故填remember。
questions.rule_summary: 情态动词could后接动词原形。

questions.explanation: 根据后文“in such a short time”及并列副词“and confidently”可知，此处表示“快速地”画竹，修饰动词paint用副词quickly。
questions.rule_summary: and连接两个并列副词修饰同一动词，quick加-ly变为quickly。

questions.explanation: 句意为“因为完整的画面已经在他脑海中了”，in one's mind意为“在某人脑海中”，结合首字母m，故填mind。
questions.rule_summary: in one's mind 为常见短语，意为“在某人脑海中”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时第三人称单数
questions.explanation: 句意为“因为他或她在做事之前准备充分”，结合首字母p可知用动词prepare；本句为一般现在时，主语he or she为第三人称单数，故填prepares。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时中，主语为he or she（第三人称单数）时，谓语动词需用三单形式。

sections.title: Passage 08 - Intangible Cultural Heritage Spring Festival
raw_text: China celebrated its first "Intangible Cultural Heritage (非物质文化遗产) (ICH) Spring Festival".
It made this year's Spring Festival very 1. s________.
ICH means traditions passed down from old times, such as paper-cutting, lion dances, and traditional food-making.
These traditions help us 2. r________ our history and culture.
In the 3. p________, the Spring Festival was mainly about family dinners and red envelopes.
But this year, we tried more traditional 4. a________.
For example, my family made paper lanterns, and our community had a fun shadow puppet show.
My grandparents even taught young people to write Spring Festival couplets!
It was interesting to mix old traditions with 5. m________ life.
This Spring Festival, while eating dumplings and watching fireworks, let's also keep the value of our traditions in mind.
Culture makes us who we are!
filled_text: China celebrated its first "Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) Spring Festival".
It made this year's Spring Festival very special.
ICH means traditions passed down from old times, such as paper-cutting, lion dances, and traditional food-making.
These traditions help us remember our history and culture.
In the past, the Spring Festival was mainly about family dinners and red envelopes.
But this year, we tried more traditional activities.
For example, my family made paper lanterns, and our community had a fun shadow puppet show.
My grandparents even taught young people to write Spring Festival couplets!
It was interesting to mix old traditions with modern life.
This Spring Festival, while eating dumplings and watching fireworks, let's also keep the value of our traditions in mind.
Culture makes us who we are!
filled_text_cn: 中国庆祝了首个“非物质文化遗产春节”。
这让今年的春节显得格外特别。
非遗是指从古代流传下来的传统，例如剪纸、舞狮和传统美食制作。
这些传统帮助我们铭记历史和文化。
在过去，春节主要是家庭聚餐和发红包。
但今年，我们尝试了更多传统活动。
例如，我们家做了纸灯笼，社区还举办了一场有趣的皮影戏表演。
我的祖父母甚至教年轻人写春联！
将古老的传统与现代生活结合起来非常有趣。
这个春节，在吃饺子和看烟花的同时，也让我们铭记传统的价值。
文化塑造了我们！

questions.explanation: 因为是首个“非遗春节”，所以使今年的春节非常“特别”；make + 宾语 + 形容词作宾补，结合首字母s，故填special。
questions.rule_summary: make sth. + adj. 表示“使某物变得……”。

questions.grammar_point_name: help sb. do sth. 省略to的不定式
questions.explanation: 这些传统帮助我们“记住”历史和文化；help sb. (to) do sth.后接动词原形，结合首字母r，故填remember。
questions.rule_summary: help sb. do sth. 意为“帮助某人做某事”，动词用原形。

questions.grammar_point_name: 固定介词短语中的名词
questions.explanation: 根据后句“But this year...”的对比及首字母p可知，此处表示“在过去”，in the past为固定短语，故填past。
questions.rule_summary: in the past 意为“在过去”，常与一般过去时连用。

questions.explanation: 后文列举的做灯笼、看皮影戏等都属于传统“活动”，activity为可数名词，空前有more修饰，故用复数形式activities。
questions.rule_summary: 以辅音字母+y结尾的可数名词变复数时，去y变i加-es，如activity→activities。

questions.explanation: 与“old traditions”相对应，此处表示将古老传统与“现代”生活结合，结合首字母m，形容词modern修饰名词life，故填modern。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词modern意为“现代的”，作定语修饰名词life。

sections.title: Passage 09 - The Invention of Printing
raw_text: Printing is an important invention.
It was invented by Bi Sheng in China about 1,000 years ago.
Before printing, people had to write books by hand, which was 1. s________ and difficult.
It took a long time to make one book.
With the invention of printing, it became much easier to copy books and share information.
Today, printing is used everywhere.
We print books, newspapers, 2. m________ and even pictures.
Printing has made it much easier to 3. s________ knowledge and ideas to people all over the world.
Thanks to printing, we can learn new things 4. f________ than before and share stories with others.
We use printing every day.
We read books and newspapers that are printed.
Printing is a great invention because it lets people share ideas easily and learn about the world.
It has 5. c________ the way we live and made the world a better place.
filled_text: Printing is an important invention.
It was invented by Bi Sheng in China about 1,000 years ago.
Before printing, people had to write books by hand, which was slow and difficult.
It took a long time to make one book.
With the invention of printing, it became much easier to copy books and share information.
Today, printing is used everywhere.
We print books, newspapers, magazines and even pictures.
Printing has made it much easier to spread knowledge and ideas to people all over the world.
Thanks to printing, we can learn new things faster than before and share stories with others.
We use printing every day.
We read books and newspapers that are printed.
Printing is a great invention because it lets people share ideas easily and learn about the world.
It has changed the way we live and made the world a better place.
filled_text_cn: 印刷术是一项重要的发明。
它大约在1000年前由中国的毕昇发明。
在印刷术发明之前，人们必须手工抄写书籍，这既慢又困难。
制作一本书需要很长时间。
随着印刷术的发明，复制书籍和分享信息变得容易多了。
如今，印刷术随处可见。
我们印刷书籍、报纸、杂志，甚至图片。
印刷术使向全世界的人们传播知识和思想变得容易得多。
多亏了印刷术，我们能比以前更快地学习新事物，并与他人分享故事。
我们每天都在使用印刷品。
我们阅读印刷出来的书籍和报纸。
印刷术是一项伟大的发明，因为它让人们轻松地分享想法并了解世界。
它改变了我们的生活方式，让世界变得更美好。

questions.explanation: 根据后句“It took a long time to make one book.”及首字母s可知，手工抄书很“慢”且困难，形容词slow与difficult并列作表语，故填slow。
questions.rule_summary: 系动词was后接并列形容词作表语。

questions.explanation: 与books、newspapers并列，结合首字母m可知指印刷刊物“杂志”，可数名词用复数形式表泛指，故填magazines。
questions.rule_summary: 并列列举同类可数名词表泛指时，均使用复数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: make it + adj. + to do sth.
questions.explanation: 句意为“向全世界传播知识和思想”，spread knowledge and ideas为常见搭配；不定式符号to后接动词原形，故填spread。
questions.rule_summary: make it + adj. + to do sth. 中it为形式宾语，to后接动词原形。

questions.explanation: 由标志词“than before”及首字母f可知，此处应用副词fast的比较级faster修饰动词learn，意为“比以前更快地学习”，故填faster。
questions.rule_summary: 出现than时用比较级，fast的比较级为faster。

questions.explanation: 句意为“它改变了我们的生活方式”，空前有助动词has，应用过去分词构成现在完成时，结合首字母c，故填changed。
questions.rule_summary: 现在完成时结构为 have/has + 过去分词。

sections.title: Passage 10 - Mike's Space Dream
raw_text: Mike is interested in space and always imagines exciting adventures among the stars.
Last night, he had a 1. d________ about exploring the universe.
He became the leader of a group of children flying in the spaceship.
Their parents sent them into space after people 2. d________ the Earth through harmful actions like cutting down forests and polluting the environment.
They were searching for a new home.
After many challenges, they 3. f________ found a new planet with fresh air and green forests.
Mike was 4. h________ that they were all safe, but he missed his parents.
Suddenly he heard his mother's 5. v________ calling his name.
Then he woke up and saw his mother standing beside his bed.
"It's time to go to school, Mike," she said.
filled_text: Mike is interested in space and always imagines exciting adventures among the stars.
Last night, he had a dream about exploring the universe.
He became the leader of a group of children flying in the spaceship.
Their parents sent them into space after people destroyed the Earth through harmful actions like cutting down forests and polluting the environment.
They were searching for a new home.
After many challenges, they finally found a new planet with fresh air and green forests.
Mike was happy that they were all safe, but he missed his parents.
Suddenly he heard his mother's voice calling his name.
Then he woke up and saw his mother standing beside his bed.
"It's time to go to school, Mike," she said.
filled_text_cn: 迈克对太空很感兴趣，总是想象在星辰之间展开激动人心的冒险。
昨晚，他做了一个探索宇宙的梦。
他成了一群乘坐宇宙飞船飞行的孩子们的领队。
在人类通过砍伐森林和污染环境等有害行为破坏地球之后，他们的父母把他们送入了太空。
他们正在寻找一个新家园。
历经重重挑战后，他们终于找到了一个拥有新鲜空气和绿色森林的新星球。
迈克很高兴大家都平安无事，但他很想念父母。
突然，他听到妈妈的声音在呼唤他的名字。
接着他醒了过来，看见妈妈正站在床边。
“迈克，该去上学了，”她说。

questions.explanation: 根据后文“Then he woke up”和“Last night, he had a ...”及首字母d可知，他做了一个“梦”；不定冠词a后接可数名词单数，故填dream。
questions.rule_summary: have a dream 意为“做梦”，不定冠词a后接可数名词单数。

questions.explanation: 根据后文“through harmful actions like cutting down forests and polluting the environment”及首字母d可知，人类“破坏”了地球；主句时态为一般过去时，此处应用过去式destroyed。
questions.rule_summary: 叙述过去发生的事件用一般过去时，destroy的过去式为destroyed。

questions.explanation: 根据“After many challenges”及首字母f可知，历经重重挑战后他们“终于”找到了新星球，副词finally修饰动词found，故填finally。
questions.rule_summary: 副词finally意为“最终，终于”，修饰动词found。

questions.explanation: 根据“that they were all safe, but he missed his parents”的转折关系及首字母h可知，迈克很“高兴”大家都平安，形容词happy作表语，故填happy。
questions.rule_summary: be happy that ... 意为“高兴……”，形容词happy作表语。

questions.explanation: 根据“heard his mother's ... calling his name”及首字母v可知，他听到了妈妈的“声音”，人发出的声音用voice，故填voice。
questions.rule_summary: voice 特指人的嗓音、说话声，his mother's voice 意为“他妈妈的声音”。
